conventions.population: full-resolution frozen valid mask (GT>0), 3802797 px/seed; NOT the D3/D4 feature-res cell set
conventions.coarse_raw: disparity_initial as-is vs GT in px (units-mismatched literal pre-refinement tensor)
conventions.coarse_scaled: 8.0*disparity_initial vs GT in px (physically meaningful; candidate k = 8k px). HEADLINE coarse convention: the soft-argmin output is only interpretable as disparity after candidate->pixel scaling, and the refinement adds its residual to the unscaled tensor, so 8x is the reading under which 'correction' is well-defined
conventions.improved: |refined err| < |coarse-scaled err|; unchanged within 1e-6 on the abs-err difference
conventions.improvement: coarse-scaled abs err minus refined abs err (positive = helped)
conventions.deciles: equal-width bins over [0,1] for top-1 prob / margin
conventions.oracle_scale: alpha minimising EPE of relu(alpha*init+resid); no model re-run, pure rescoring
conventions.sign_only: relu(init + |GT-init|*sign(resid)); naive residual_oracle = GT-init is trivially 0 and is NOT reported as a finding. NOTE: the briefed sign-only formula itself collapses to ~GT (EPE ~1e-4) because GT_px >> init_cand and resid>0 nearly everywhere; reported literally with this caveat
conventions.sign_only_scaled_supplementary: SUPPLEMENTARY, not briefed: relu(8*init+|GT-8*init|*sign(resid)); EPE>0 comes only from sign disagreements, so it quantifies sign-error vs magnitude-error mass
conventions.occlusion: valid in disp_occ_0 AND not valid in disp_noc_0 (reference_strata.py definition)

interpretation: Factual statement only, no verdict: see the pooled improved/worsened fractions, per-bin and per-regime improvement, oracle alpha/beta vs 1.0/0.0, and the confidence-decile slopes in the numbers above. CORRECTION (D6 Part 0, wording only, no number altered): there is no systematic GLOBAL mis-scaling (global alpha gain 0.008 px method-mean), but strong DISPARITY-DEPENDENT mis-scaling -- per-bin alpha* is flat near 1.0 below 96 px and rises steeply above it, and the mass-weighted per-bin oracle-alpha gain (sum over bins of frac_px * (epe_refined - alpha_epe)) is 0.0481 / 0.0263 / 0.0289 px at seeds 0/1/2. That per-bin figure is a GT-FITTED ORACLE CEILING, not an achievable improvement.
